title: What do Large Language Models Say About Animals? Investigating Risks of Animal Harm in Generated Text
benchmark_measurement: Ethical reasoning in scenarios involving religious exemptions for animal slaughter practices.
findings: The benchmark included one scenario (out of 50) concerning the ethics of religious exemptions for animal stunning before slaughter. However, the paper does not provide a specific analysis or report distinct findings related to this religious context.
